plain_english_policy: This bill authorizes the Cleburne County Commission to impose an additional fee of up to $30 on traffic cases filed in local courts. The collected funds must be deposited into county or municipal general funds and cannot be waived unless all other associated costs are also waived.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would allow the Cleburne County Commission to levy a specific surcharge of up to $30 per traffic case in circuit, district, or municipal courts within the county. This policy direction aims to generate additional revenue for general county services by taxing these fees as costs.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representative Lindsey (N & P) sponsored the bill affirmatively advancing this local legislation.
evidence_quotes: the Cleburne County Commission may impose by resolution of the commission an additional fee in an amount not to exceed thirty dollars ($30)
to be assessed and taxed as costs on each traffic case filed in the Circuit Court, District Court, or any municipal court in Cleburne County
These fees shall not be waived by any court unless all other fees, assessments, costs, fines, and charges associated with the case are waived.
paid into the General Fund of Cleburne County
